proposals.name: P1_notice_stage_replaced_by_one_inverter
proposals.description: Replace the 4-part NPN 'notice' stage per rail (D, NPN, 1 k, 10 k) by one SN74LVC1G10 (NAND3 with its three inputs tied = inverter; this MPN is already on the board as U8). ISO7710 (default HIGH) stays; audit.rs default-low rule untouched. The inverter shares the rail's existing 5 V bypass capacitor (civcc1).

proposals.name: P2_HS_monitors_via_ISO6721FB_one_reinforced_crossing
proposals.description: P1's notice deletion, plus: HS-A/HS-B monitors cross to the LS domain through a functional-class ISO6721FB (default low), a NAND3 on the LS 5 V rail combines the three 'good' lines, U32 (ISO7710, default high) is the only reinforced crossing of the monitor group; the SELV-side OR3 (U25) is deleted.

proposals.name: P3_permit_DIS_stage_FET_free
proposals.description: Per leg: PERMIT-FET + 330 ohm pull-up + OR2 -> one NAND2 (SN74LVC1G00, SOT-23-5, same pins/footprint as the SN74LVC1G32 it replaces): DIS = NAND(permit_gate, BIAS_GOOD). U40 (Schmitt buffer after the 10 us filter) becomes the inverting SN74LVC1G14 (same footprint), so the internal net BIAS_BAD becomes BIAS_GOOD (it is not on J4). Keeps the 100 ohm, the 100 k pull-down and the 10 k DIS pull-up.
